preregistration_note: 5 falsifiers pre-registered as paper hypotheses. Activation requires (a) lab partnership agreement, (b) IACUC/ethics approval per relevant jurisdiction (EU 2010/63 / UK ASPA+Sentience Act / NIH PHS / Korean APA+voluntary 2010/63), (c) anima HEXA Φ pipeline ready on 64-ch surface EMG. NO measurement performed in this cycle.

common_test_substrate.species_first_choice: Octopus minor (낙지) — Korean native, lower import friction
common_test_substrate.modality: non-invasive surface EMG via Ag/AgCl flexible patch, anchored over axial nerve cord projection
common_test_substrate.synchronization: Lab Streaming Layer (LSL) with 4-cam 60fps DeepLabCut behavioral capture
common_test_substrate.phi_pipeline: anima HEXA Mk.XII v3 paradigm-v11-octopus-adapted (G0 dropped, ≥4/6 G1..G6 AND G7)
common_test_substrate.bipartition_construction: 8 anatomical per-arm + 1 whole-body (additional K=8 random as control)

falsifiers.name: exclusion_violation_per_arm_sum_dominates
falsifiers.hypothesis: Sum of per-arm Φ exceeds whole-body Φ — direct violation of IIT 4.0 exclusion postulate; supports Carls-Diamante community-of-minds

test_design.input: free-behaving octopus, mixed task pool (single-arm reach + bilateral object transfer + chemo-stim sucker test)
test_design.measurement: 9 grain Φ_min via covariance K=8 random bipartition per grain

falsifiers.fail_implication: exclusion postulate holds — single integrated consciousness hypothesis (Tononi standard) supported

falsifiers.name: exclusion_confirmation_whole_dominates
falsifiers.hypothesis: Whole-body Φ exceeds both max per-arm Φ and per-arm Φ sum — standard IIT 4.0 expectation
falsifiers.pass_threshold: Φ_whole / max_i Φ_arm_i > 1.50 AND Φ_whole > sum_i Φ_arm_i
falsifiers.fail_implication: per-arm grain holds substantive Φ-mass — exclusion weakened, layered consciousness hypothesis supported

falsifiers.name: task_dependent_exclusion_grain_shift
falsifiers.hypothesis: argmax-grain of Φ shifts between solo-arm task (per-arm dominant) and multi-arm coordination task (whole-body dominant) — exclusion grain is task-dependent

conditions: B: bilateral object transfer between arms
test_design.metric: P(argmax_grain shifts between A and B) across 100 trial pairs

falsifiers.fail_implication: exclusion grain is task-invariant — supports IIT 4.0 standard fixed-grain interpretation

falsifiers.name: chemosensory_sucker_phi_island
falsifiers.hypothesis: Sucker chemoreceptor cluster forms an independent Φ-island distinct from ANC (extends Kang 2023 sucker chemoreceptor finding)

test_design.input: chemo-stimulus only condition (texture panel with chemical gradient)
grains: sucker-cluster (~10 suckers per arm in stim contact)

falsifiers.fail_implication: suckers are pure sensors, no independent Φ-grain

falsifiers.name: anesthesia_gradient_exclusion_disintegration_order
falsifiers.hypothesis: During light anesthesia (sevoflurane sub-MAC) onset, whole-body Φ disintegrates faster than mean per-arm Φ — top-down exclusion collapse pattern

test_design.anesthetic: sevoflurane sub-MAC (≤ 1%), monitored by behavioral cessation timing
test_design.measurement: Φ per grain at 10 s intervals

falsifiers.pass_threshold: dΦ_whole/dt ≥ 2x mean(dΦ_arm_i/dt) across grains during onset
falsifiers.fail_implication: if per-arm Φ disintegrates faster — supports bottom-up consciousness, reverse exclusion direction
falsifiers.ethical_activation_constraint: PAPER HYPOTHESIS ONLY — requires SZN or MBL collaboration with full ethics board approval; CANNOT be activated under Korean lab consortium with $0 budget given the lack of explicit Korean cephalopod IACUC framework

honest_c3_falsifier_caveats: All 5 falsifiers require partnership + ethics approval — currently 0
F-N24-1 'sum > whole' definition is non-canonical relative to IIT 4.0 grain-Φ_max comparison; pre-registered as anima's own composite definition (paradigm v11 geometric-mean parallel)
Surface EMG → IIT Φ extraction has no prior PASS proof — F-N24-1..4 success requires that EMG covariance carries IIT-relevant information
F-N24-5 ethical activation blocked at Korean lab consortium tier, deferred to SZN/MBL follow-up cycle
G0 axis drop reduces FINAL_PASS strength — pre-registered as octopus-substrate-required adaptation
K=8 random bipartition + 8 anatomical bipartition design risks bipartition-cardinality artifact; control via shuffled-anatomical-label condition pre-registered
Pre-registration cannot be sealed in raw#71 registry until partnership agreement confirms the substrate is accessible
